name: vika
description: A local personal agent core with connector processes and an activity web module.

scripts.check: for file in scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$file" || exit 1; done && for file in packages/daemon/src/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/actions/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/connectors/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/extensions/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/meeting/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/weixin/*.mjs packages/daemon/src/email/*.mjs packages/daemon/scripts/*.mjs packages/web/src/*.mjs packages/web/scripts/*.mjs packages/web/public/*.js packages/updater/src/*.mjs packages/updater/bin/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
